demos.title: Facet panel
demos.description: Counts are computed with each facet's own filter removed, so picking one value does not zero its siblings. Labels come from the category schema through @stapel/attributes-react; a slug the server skipped shows 'not counted', never 0.

demos.title: Search page
demos.description: The composed /s screen: the query box bound to setText, the filter panel (category and location slots, numeric ranges, drill-down facets), the sort and page-size toolbar, and one keyset page of cards with the DSA promoted marking explained in words rather than in a tooltip.

variants.description: Filters beside the results, the way a catalogue reads on a desktop.

demos.title: Ranking disclosure
demos.description: Which parameters order the results and how much each weighs, straight from the scorer registry. Parameters the configured engine cannot evaluate are listed with their reason rather than filtered out.

demos.title: Search results
